hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that runs each coin on a concentrated bonding curve (800M tokens, ETH-paired). Enforces block+1 trading start, first-hour 2% per-wallet cap with auto-refund, decaying anti-snipe fee premium, and 70/30 creator/platform fee split. Graduates to a permanently locked full-range LP in the same pool when the curve sells out.
